engine.notes: One company covers the city: the Stick Horses in Pants, whose own site has lapsed, now run Peak Improv Theater, and independent teams like Whimsicult play there. Loonees Comedy Corner is stand-up; Millibo Art Theatre, Cottonwood Center for the Arts and the Fine Arts Center list no improv programme, and Colorado School of Acting's Springs site is a kids-and-teens satellite.

entries.name: Peak Improv Theater
entries.summary: Colorado Springs' only dedicated improv theater, a 100-plus-seat room with a bar opened in 2024 by the Stick Horses in Pants, the city's longest-running improv team (since 2004), with weekly shows, a Thursday jam and a 101-to-conservatory s
entries.schedule: Jam Thursdays 7:30pm ($5 suggested); Stick Horses Fridays, pay what you want; rotating Saturday shows
signals: Opened 2024; founders' troupe Stick Horses in Pants formed 2004
Fall terms Sep-Oct and Nov-Dec 2026; first 101 drop-in free
100+ seats, bar, stand-up and sketch workshops too
entries.reasons: A new building but a 20-year-old company behind it, the city's only full class ladder with dated terms, weekly shows and a jam; standing is still local.
